name: magpie-breeze-blue
description: Breeze Blue TTS provider plugin for Magpie: browser login for the web session (works on a NAS or in Docker) and daily credit check-in
author: LumenMarch

summary.en: Breeze Blue text-to-speech with daily credit check-in. The sign-in page opens in your own browser, so it works on a NAS or in Docker too.
summary.zh: Breeze Blue 文本转语音，附带每日积分自动领取。登录页开在你自己的浏览器里，装在 NAS / Docker 上同样可用。
